top_findings: Critical: Game hubs emit a fabricated AggregateRating (ratingCount = number of Autnic's own articles) on 9 URLs; src/views/Game.astro:68-70
High: About and llms.txt promise a dated correction log on every article; 0 of 63 articles populate it
High: The 'We buy what we review' tagline contradicts 2 of 4 reviews, which were played on publisher codes (disclosed in-review)
High: The article hero srcset offers only 1440w/1920w because Fig.astro's exact-match filter drops the missing 900w variant
High: No max-image-preview:large, so Discover can't use large image cards
quick_wins: Delete the aggregateRating spread in Game.astro:68-70
Snap requested widths to the nearest available variant in Fig.astro:37-39
Set alt={bodyShotCaption} on the body screenshot, Article.astro:176
Replace the leftover 'Your ultimate gaming blog' H2 on the homepage

findings.title: No cache purge on D1 publish
findings.description: CACHE_TTL 86400 (wrangler.jsonc:97), swr=345600; the targeted purge was removed (src/lib/cache.ts:23-27). Corrections published to D1 can take up to 24h to reach every edge.
findings.recommendation: Purge the article URLs in all locales from the D1 publish hook.

findings.title: IndexNow fires only on git deploys
findings.description: deploy.yml:121-126 is the only caller; src/lib/indexnow.ts:54 is never called from D1 publishes.
findings.recommendation: Call submitToIndexNow from the same D1 publish hook.

findings.title: Trailing-slash duplicates return 200
findings.description: astro.config.mjs:57 trailingSlash 'ignore'; /reviews and /reviews/ both return 200 (canonical is correct).
findings.recommendation: 301 to the slash form in middleware.

findings.title: www takes 2 redirect hops
findings.description: http://www.autnic.com -> https://www -> https://autnic.com
findings.recommendation: Single Cloudflare redirect rule.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Reviews of 1,700-1,938 words with structured version/platform/playtime/copy-source disclosure
About charter: paid copies, ad separation, scoring rubric

findings.title: Correction-log promise unmet
findings.description: About.astro:62/86 and llms.txt promise a dated log on every article; corrections is populated in 0/63 files and only renders when non-empty (Article.astro:189-201).
findings.recommendation: Always render the block, with 'No corrections since publication' when empty; log real corrections.

findings.title: Tagline overclaims
findings.description: 'We buy what we review' in the home meta/og/WebSite/llms.txt; Onimusha and Dawnwalker reviews were played on publisher codes (disclosed in method).
findings.recommendation: Reword to match the About policy.

findings.title: No first-hand imagery
findings.description: All review images are publisher press assets.
findings.recommendation: 1-2 reviewer-captured screenshots per review.

findings.title: News built around another outlet's take
findings.description: e.g. onimusha-way-of-the-sword-critical-split, structured as 'Kotaku says X'.
findings.recommendation: Lead with Autnic's own angle, then cite.

findings.title: Author credentials can't be checked
findings.description: No named prior outlets or profile links; initials avatars.
findings.recommendation: One external credential per author.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Query-led titles of 39-51 chars; hook kept in the H1
Every article one click from the homepage

findings.title: Hub descriptions promise 'where to buy it'
findings.description: Template at src/i18n/ui.ts:169 (en), :689 (de); no buy links render on hubs.
findings.recommendation: Render the whereToBuy block on hubs or drop the clause.

findings.title: Review titles carry no hook
findings.description: 10-20 chars of spare title budget unused.
findings.recommendation: Query first, then a short hook.

findings.title: FF7 editions page lacks a comparison table
findings.description: 0 tables, 1 outbound link, for a comparison query.
findings.recommendation: Editions x contents x price table plus buy links.

findings.title: Template filler H2 on the homepage
findings.description: 'Your ultimate gaming blog' (Home.astro pick-h).
findings.recommendation: Replace with real section copy.

findings.title: Identical titles across locales
findings.description: Game hubs, authors, cookies.
findings.recommendation: Localized hub suffixes.

findings.title: Fabricated AggregateRating
findings.description: Game.astro:69 ratingCount: Math.max(1, posts.length); live ratingValue 8.2, ratingCount 3 on 9 hub URLs.
findings.recommendation: Delete it until real user votes exist.

findings.title: Orphaned homepage WebSite, no sameAs
findings.description: Home.astro:123-130 emits a bare WebSite; no sameAs anywhere in src.
findings.recommendation: Emit [Organization, WebSite] with publisher @id; add sameAs in site.ts:42-53.

findings.title: dateModified not tied to corrections
findings.description: Article.astro:62; content.config.ts:37,64.
findings.recommendation: Zod refine in the content schema.

findings.title: itemReviewed has no url
findings.description: Article.astro:81.
findings.recommendation: Link to the game hub.

findings.title: Article hero srcset lacks small variants
findings.description: Article.astro:109 requests 900w, which 404s; the Fig.astro:37-39 exact-match filter leaves 1440w/1920w only (307 KB minimum). Review lab LCP 10.3s (single run, with a 5.25s lab TTFB anomaly; re-verify).
findings.recommendation: Snap requested widths to the nearest existing variant in Fig.astro.

findings.title: Font preloads compete with the LCP image
findings.description: 41% of the homepage LCP is element render delay; 3 font preloads at top priority.
findings.recommendation: Drop the JetBrains Mono preload; keep Chakra only if above the fold.

findings.title: Unanchored Organization entity
findings.description: Orphaned homepage WebSite; no sameAs.
findings.recommendation: Same fix as Schema.

findings.title: llms.txt repeats the unmet correction-log claim
findings.description: 0 articles have corrections.
findings.recommendation: Resolved by the correction-log fix.

findings.title: Short passages
findings.description: Paragraphs of 17-85 words.
findings.recommendation: Answer-first under question H2s; no padding.

findings.title: No max-image-preview:large
findings.description: Base.astro:102 only emits noindex.
findings.recommendation: Emit max-image-preview:large on indexable pages.

findings.title: Body screenshot has empty alt
findings.description: Article.astro:176 alt="" despite a figcaption.
findings.recommendation: alt={bodyShotCaption}.

findings.title: No image sitemap entries
findings.description: sitemap.xml.ts has no image namespace.
findings.recommendation: Add image:image for cover and hero.

findings.title: og:image has no dimensions or alt
findings.description: Base.astro:109.
findings.recommendation: Add og:image:width/height/alt.
